content: When I Work: two-layer model. Positions are the primary job title or duty, assigned to a user and to shifts (coarse role). Tags are additional eligibility layered on top of a position (certification, language, tenure, geography), assigned to users and to shifts; tags are invisible to employees. Eligibility for a tagged shift requires BOTH matching position AND all required tags, cumulative AND logic, and this restriction persists through the shift lifecycle (release, drop, open-shift claim) so an unqualified person never sees or claims it even after it is dropped. User feedback: some users still want better tools for tracking qualifications and restricting open shifts by training, implying the tag model does not fully close the gap for complex credential tracking such as expiry-based rules.
